title: Managing journalist burnout on Mac: practical steps for your mental health
metaTitle: Combat journalist burnout on Mac: practical mental health management
description: Learn how to manage journalist burnout and mental health on your Mac with actionable, low-cost strategies and tools for a sustainable workflow.
intro: Journalist burnout is a widespread reality, with over 80 percent of journalists reporting chronic stress in the past year. Managing your mental health requires intentional habits and tools that integrate into your daily Mac workflow.
tldr: Journalist burnout affects over 80 percent of professionals due to high trauma exposure and systemic pressure.
Effective management involves active coping strategies and using native Mac tools to reduce daily friction.
Lazur helps by handling routine tasks and information organization, allowing you to focus on your well-being.
Small changes to your digital environment can significantly lower your daily stress levels.

blocks.text: Journalism is a profession of high stakes and constant pressure. You are often exposed to traumatic events while maintaining a 24/7 news cycle. This environment makes you vulnerable to secondary trauma, compassion fatigue, and persistent anxiety.

Many newsrooms maintain a culture that discourages asking for help. This silence often worsens the impact of your work. Understanding that your response is a normal reaction to an abnormal situation is the first step toward management.
Burnout in this field is not a personal failure. It is a systemic issue driven by several factors.

items: Trauma exposure from covering war, violence, and disasters.
Constant digital connectivity and online harassment.
Lack of institutional support for mental health.

blocks.text: Practical fixes for your daily routine
You can start managing your mental health today without expensive subscriptions or complex setups. Focus on small, consistent changes.

items: Set clear boundaries for your digital life. Use the Focus feature in macOS to silence notifications during your downtime.
Practice active coping. When you feel overwhelmed, address the specific task causing the stress rather than avoiding it.
Join peer-led support groups. Sharing experiences with colleagues reduces the sense of isolation common in the industry.
Use journaling to process your day. Apps like Day One allow for encrypted, private entries that help you identify emotional patterns.

blocks.text: If you are experiencing severe symptoms, please seek professional help from clinicians trained in the specific culture of journalism.

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It helps you reduce the friction of your daily work, which often contributes to stress. By simplifying your interactions with your computer, you can save energy for what matters.

faq.question: Is Lazur a mental health app?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is a productivity tool designed to help you manage your digital workspace and routine tasks on your Mac.

faq.question: Can Lazur help me with my workload?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur can help you organize research, set reminders, and dictate notes, which can reduce the cognitive load of managing a busy schedule.

faq.question: Does Lazur store my personal data?
faq.answer: No. Lazur only processes data while you hold the activation shortcut. Audio and screenshots are not stored.
